nodes.role_raw: Mach-Zehnder Interferometer (2x2) with integrated TiN heaters
nodes.notes: C-band operation. Use 500 nm-wide waveguides throughout the MZI. Include integrated TiN heaters (one per arm or as required by design) with heater length = 10 µm. Provide two optical input ports and two optical output ports per MZI (2x2).

nodes.role_raw: Mach-Zehnder Interferometer (2x2) with integrated TiN heaters
nodes.notes: C-band operation. Use 500 nm-wide waveguides throughout the MZI. Include integrated TiN heaters (one per arm or as required by design) with heater length = 10 µm. Provide two optical input ports and two optical output ports per MZI (2x2).

notes: Cascade the two MZIs in series by routing the two outputs of MZI #1 into the two inputs of MZI #2 (maintain path-length symmetry and consistent port ordering).
Keep waveguide width at 500 nm for all interconnects between the MZIs.
Expose final outputs at the outputs of MZI #2; expose initial inputs at the inputs of MZI #1.
